costume.name: Linen Ghost
costume.description: An off-white linen drape over a light base outfit, finished with brown lace-up boots.
costume.alt: Linen Ghost: off-white linen sheet to drape, comfortable light base top, comfortable light base pants, brown leather lace-up boots, optional shawl pin or drape fastener, arranged on pale grey.

pieces.name: Off-white linen sheet to drape
pieces.styleNotes: A large, loose-woven off-white linen sheet with a slightly rumpled, aged texture that drapes in soft folds to the ankle. Vintage flax or stonewashed linen gives a classic, spooky storybook ghost look.
queries: vintage off-white linen bed sheet flax Etsy
handmade stonewashed natural linen flat sheet king size ivory
antique European hemp linen sheet cream undyed

matches.reason: A natural undyed, unbleached French flax linen sheet with a vintage-washed finish that is a little rough at first, giving the aged, rumpled texture of a storybook ghost, in a twin size of 72 x 102 inches.

Described as a homespun, textured, heavyweight 100% natural flax linen flat sheet in off-white, with an oversized cut that suits draping, though the twin size is listed and the $202 price is steep for a costume.
A linen flat sheet in natural oatmeal color, a slightly warmer neutral than off-white, made from wide fabric with no center seam, which helps a clean drape for a ghost costume.

pieces.name: Comfortable light base top
pieces.styleNotes: A lightweight, breathable cotton or linen tee or long-sleeve in white or cream, worn underneath the sheet. Keep it slim and plain so it doesn't bulk up the drape.
queries: handmade organic cotton long sleeve tee cream lightweight
vintage 90s plain white cotton t-shirt single stitch
small brand linen blend crew neck top off-white

matches.reason: Plain crew tee in undyed natural 4.3 oz 100% organic cotton jersey with a rib collar, a cream-toned color that suits a light base layer under an off-white sheet; the description says it is sewn in the San Francisco Bay Area.
White lightweight organic cotton tee, but it is described as oversized and slouchy, which may add more bulk under the sheet than the slim plain base layer calls for.
White 100% organic cotton tee in a ribbed needlepoint fabric with a chunky scalloped neck binding, but the texture and cropped cut are less plain and slim than the base layer calls for.

pieces.name: Comfortable light base pants
pieces.styleNotes: Light, relaxed pants in cream, white or pale grey cotton or linen that stay hidden beneath the sheet. A drawstring waist keeps them comfortable all night.
queries: handmade linen drawstring pants natural off-white
vintage cotton drawstring trousers cream lightweight
small brand organic cotton lounge pants ecru

matches.reason: White 100% linen pants with a straight leg, adjustable drawstring waist and hip pockets, garment washed for softness, matching the light linen base the costume calls for.
No-bleach white hemp pants with a relaxed fit, elastic mid-rise waistband and adjustable drawstring, a light neutral that suits wearing beneath a sheet.

Undyed natural 100% organic cotton jersey lounge pants with a relaxed straight leg and stretchy waistband (not a drawstring), sewn in the San Francisco Bay Area, so the light neutral color stays hidden under a sheet.

pieces.name: Brown leather lace-up boots
pieces.styleNotes: Worn, brown leather lace-up boots with a rounded toe and a low stacked heel, in a vintage work or Victorian style. Scuffed, patinated leather adds to the haunted look peeking out from under the hem.
queries: vintage brown leather lace-up boots women's Victorian style
handmade brown leather lace up ankle boots Etsy
vintage men's brown leather work boots lace-up distressed

matches.reason: Plain toe boot in saddle tan Minerva vegetable-tanned leather from Badalassi Carlo, with leather uppers, lining, insole and outsole; the tan color is a warm brown-compatible shade and the leather will develop patina, but at $435 it costs a lot for a costume piece.
Saddle brown Krumenauer leather boot with a narrow, refined 415 last and a dressy Dakota sole; the description says it steps away from the work-boot style, so it reads more polished than worn.

Brown leather lace-up boot with waxed cotton laces, Goodyear welt construction and a studded rubber outsole, a work-boot style that works under a ghost sheet, though it is a modern new pair rather than a worn, patinated one.

pieces.name: Optional shawl pin or drape fastener
pieces.styleNotes: A small antique-style brass or pewter shawl pin, brooch or kilt pin that secures the sheet at the shoulder or chin without showing much. A tarnished vintage finish suits the ghostly theme.
queries: vintage brass shawl pin brooch antique
handmade pewter cloak pin fastener Etsy
antique silver kilt pin large safety pin brooch

matches.reason: A white brass shawl pin about 2 inches across with a 4-inch pin, made by Jul Designs, it can fasten the sheet at the shoulder and a tarnished finish would suit the vintage theme, though the metal is listed as white brass rather than antique brass or pewter.
A rosewood off-center shawl pin from Jul Designs that could hold the sheet in place, but it is wood rather than the antique brass or pewter metal requested.
A genuine leather shawl cuff in whiskey brown that closes with snaps at 7.5 inches long, it holds a shawl but is a cuff rather than a pin, brooch or kilt pin and has no antique metal look.
